topic: Low speed wind tunnel and wind tunnel balances
syllabus_extract: Low speed wind tunnel and wind tunnel balances. Demonstration on pressure plotting experiments. Measurements of lift and drag in wind tunnel.
specific_objectives: 11.1.5.1 Trainee will be able to explain about wind tunnel operation

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Demonstration on pressure plotting experiments. Measurements of lift and drag in wind tunnel. Safety: Ensure tunnel is off before accessing balance. Instructor supervision required during setup.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of a wind tunnel?
Name two types of aerodynamic forces measured in a wind tunnel.
Why is a low speed wind tunnel used for preliminary testing?

topics: Principles of Low Speed Wind Tunnel
development.content:
Principles of Low Speed Wind Tunnel
Components of Wind Tunnel System
Operation of Wind Tunnel Fan
Flow Straightening Screens
Test Section Characteristics

Types of Wind Tunnel Balances
Strain Gauge Balance Principles
Force Measurement Mechanisms
Moment Measurement Mechanisms
Calibration of Balances

Pressure Plotting Experiments
Data Recording Procedures
Lift and Drag Calculation
Analysis of Test Results
Error Sources in Measurement

summary_questions: Explain how a strain gauge balance measures lift force.
Describe the role of the test section in a low speed wind tunnel.
List three precautions required during wind tunnel balance calibration.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on the differences between a low speed wind tunnel and a high speed wind tunnel, referencing the next lesson plan (LP 02) on High Speed Wind Tunnels.
